pairs.why: k6 resolves ES modules on the FILESYSTEM and rejects bare specifiers outright, so this service's k6 load library cannot import the shared Clerk re-mint (packages/tools/loadtest/k6/session.js) by package name — verified against the k6 binary. The alternative is three copies of the refresh logic, whose absence cost run 34041143051 every authenticated request after 60 seconds.

Repo-root tooling imported by an infra-global unit test for its PURE functions. Not debt: `packages/infra/global` is a CDK app that is never published or containerized, and its `__tests__` never ship, so the shipped-coupling this rule guards cannot occur here. Spawning the script instead would downgrade pure-function tests to black-box subprocess tests. The structural fix is a root-level test project owning the ~20 tests of repo-root tooling that currently live in infra-global/__tests__; that is a separate change, not a silencing.
